answer: Each identity must speak for five minutes in a live, recorded public debate on a fresh topic, judged by two moderators in a juniper garden lit by a single lantern, with its stance set in marble on the public board. A hired speaker costs about $75 per fake, and the same voice or the same argument twice is flagged and both identities are slashed. A farm of 100 fakes needs 100 distinct speakers and 100 distinct stances, so the cost rises with every added fake.
